srList.sentence: Donor selection criteria were as follows: age <55 years, blood group compatibility, intubation period of less than five days, not being a heavy smoker (20 pack-years), lack of Gram-negative or fungal growth in cultures, a partial oxygen pressure (PaO2)fraction of inspired oxygen (FiO2) PF ratio of >=250, positive end-expiratory pressure (PEEP) of 5 cmH2O, lack of extensive infiltration, pneumothorax or trauma findings (contusion) on chest X-ray, and lack of a history of chronic lung disease.
